Name: Seven Deadly Sins (ENG Translation)
Author: cassellate
Description:
[size=4]The latest upload is up to date as of SDS 1.6-3.8.2! If a new version of SDS is released, please hold off on downloading it until the translation is updated or you risk broken dialogue strings.
[/size]
Disclaimer: Chinese is my native language, and I've done my best to preserve the cultural context and the quirks of each character while making the dialogue flow naturally. Even so there will likely still be quite a few errors. Please bear with me as I continue to make updates!

[b][size=4]Please scroll to the bottom to see trigger warnings![/size][/b]

[b][quote]INSTRUCTIONS[/quote][/b]
1. Download the original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15100]here[/url]﻿ (as well as the portraits in the "Optional FIles" section of the Files tab) and place it into your mods folder. Portraits go into your Portraiture folder. (Note: if you're having trouble getting the portraits to display, please read the instructions on the official [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] mod page).
2. Download this mod. Copy it into your mods folder and [b]overwrite[/b] all duplicate files. This replaces the original files with their translated counterparts.
3. Launch Stardew and enjoy!

[b][quote]COMPATIBILITY[/quote][/b]
This mod is compatible with major expansions such as [b]SVE (Stardew Valley Expanded)[/b], [b]East Scarp[/b], [b]Ridgeside Village[/b], and [b]Zuzu City[/b].
[list]
[*][b]For SVE 1.6:[/b] Use [b]version 3.6.3 or higher[/b] for basic compatibility. [i](Note: Some minor inconsistencies may occur. Please report any issues you encounter!) [Don't report them to me but to the original mod author][/i]
[/list]
Compatible with Stardew Valley version 1.6. The original mod has a Stardew 1.5 compatible version too, but I'm not sure if my translations will work for it.

[b][quote]INTRODUCTION[/quote][/b]
[b]Welcome to the meticulously crafted haven for sinners, dear player!
[/b]
Here, you will encounter every bearer of sin: individuals who carry the first, and perhaps the final, transgressions. Desires and cravings, redemption and corruption, nobility or selfishness, beauty or depravity... countless features shape their essence, but the sins they bear are the only truth.
Thorns and blood will lacerate the feet of those who tread the path of atonement, letting their greedy malice bleed away. The gods watch from afar, ensuring that no participating evil can escape judgment.
They will ultimately repay the suffering they have inflicted upon others.
Even if they were merely guided here by "fate," it was their own fervent desires that resonated and led them to make their choices. Thus, they must fulfill one final purpose here. Unfortunately, whether they are masterminds or mere pawns, none shall escape unscathed from this vortex.
The world itself will crumble under the weight of madness, and the threads of balance will snap.
And now, at this very moment - unexpected, unplanned - [b]you[/b] have arrived. As if drawn by an inescapable providence, you coincidentally step into this place alongside them.
So, as the wildcard, will you become the eye of the storm, pushing this farce to its absolute limit? Or will you bring this wicked scheme to an end, preserving the eternal order?
Well then, let us eagerly await the outcome.
With that, our brief introduction concludes. As the prologue's narrators, we shall now take our leave. The time for [b]your[/b] choices has come. Go forth, and raise the curtain on this crumbling farce!

[b]Lucas:[/b] [i]"Rather than chasing elusive affection, why not indulge in the simplest ecstasy? After all, no one escapes desire—so why not become the one who dominates all desires?"[/i]
[b]Pelette:[/b] [i]"Rage will burn away my existence like flames. From beginning to end... I was never truly here."[/i]
[b]Sariel:[/b] [i]"No amount of desire can ever fill my stomach. So in the end... will I devour myself?"[/i]
[b]Uriel:[/b] [i]"Those who wield power no longer look down upon the world. Eternal laws crack under the weight of human hearts. If anyone evades judgment... do I even have the right to condemn them?"[/i]
[b]Lane & Rane:[/b] [i]"I want this, I want that—I even want death! Ahh, in the end, will we lose everything because of this 'desire'?... Oh well, that sounds absolutely delightful!"[/i]
[b]Hovsep:[/b] [i]"So tired, so tired... I don’t want to think anymore... I just... can’t..."[/i]
[b]Moore:[/b] [i]"I despise this world. Just die."[/i]

This mod, passionately developed by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ricehit?gameId=1303][b]Ricehit[/b][/url], is a comprehensive female-oriented experience featuring:

[list]
[*][b]High-definition character portraits (100+)[/b]
[*][b]Thousands of meticulously crafted narratives[/b]
[*][b]Hundreds of thousands of words of character dialogue[/b]
[/list]Centered around the [b]Seven Sins[/b], it weaves a unique and expansive tale within a grand world, waiting for you to uncover its secrets.

Let the story unfold.

[quote][b]Trigger Warnings[/b][/quote]
Open the spoiler tags for details (may contain spoilers)

Violence/profanity
[spoiler]Threats of violence and graphic descriptions of war from the character Pelette. No hate speech or slurs.[/spoiler] 

Sexual Content
[spoiler]Intimacy scenes with Uriel, Lucas, Rane, Lane, Pelette, and Hovsep. The graphic scenes only occur post-marriage.[/spoiler]

Heavy religious themes/Blasphemy
[spoiler]One of the main locations added is a church with a priest NPC. Also, the character of Uriel is a fallen angel and has frequent musings about faith.[/spoiler]
